categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the semiconductor industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of large-diameter silicon materials, silicon components, and large-size semiconductor silicon wafers. These products are essential for integrated circuit etching equipment and semiconductor manufacturing. The business segments include large-diameter silicon materials for etching, silicon components used in plasma etching machines, and large-size semiconductor silicon wafers targeting advanced chip manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced crystal growth technologies such as no-magnetic-field large-diameter single crystal silicon manufacturing, solid-liquid coexistence interface control, and optimized thermal field design. It also employs precision machining techniques for silicon components, including micro-hole drilling and surface polishing, critical for plasma etching equipment. Additionally, it has developed proprietary CVD-SiC coating technologies and advanced polishing and annealing processes to enhance product quality and meet stringent semiconductor manufacturing requirements.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include semiconductor silicon component manufacturers in Japan, South Korea, and China, plasma etching equipment manufacturers like Lam Research and Tokyo Electron, and leading integrated circuit manufacturers such as Samsung, SK Hynix, Intel, TSMC, and Chinese domestic chipmakers. The company serves the semiconductor manufacturing industry, particularly focusing on etching equipment and integrated circuit fabrication sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, Japan, and South Korea, with sales to major semiconductor markets in these countries. It has production facilities in China (Jinzhou, Quanzhou, Shanghai) and subsidiaries in Japan. The domestic Chinese market is increasingly important due to the growth of local semiconductor manufacturing and equipment production.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the upstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain, producing high-purity silicon materials and silicon components that serve as critical raw materials for plasma etching equipment manufacturers and integrated circuit fabricators. It provides foundational materials and components essential for chip manufacturing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding production capacity for large-diameter silicon materials, advancing precision machining of silicon components, and developing high-value, low-defect large-size silicon wafers. The company emphasizes innovation in crystal growth, defect control, and surface processing technologies. It actively collaborates with domestic plasma etching equipment manufacturers and integrated circuit producers to customize products and accelerate certification and adoption. R&D investments focus on meeting next-generation etching and chip fabrication requirements, including AI-related high-performance chips.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of semiconductor-grade silicon materials, silicon components, and large-size silicon wafers to equipment manufacturers and integrated circuit fabricators. The company uses a customer order plus self-stock production model, with sales conducted mainly via direct sales to large customers. Revenue recognition occurs at the point of control transfer, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the global large-diameter silicon materials market, competing with established international suppliers such as Shin-Etsu Chemical (Japan). It has a competitive advantage in technology, product quality, and production scale, especially for 16-inch and larger silicon materials. In silicon components, it is among the few integrated manufacturers in China with full upstream to downstream capabilities. The company benefits from the growing domestic semiconductor ecosystem and supply chain localization trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 302.7 million, a 124.19% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 41.15 million, turning profitable after previous losses. The company’s total assets reached nearly RMB 2 billion with steady growth. R&D investment accounted for 8.26% of revenue. The company has expanded production capacity and improved profitability, reflecting a strong growth trajectory aligned with semiconductor industry recovery.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced manufacturing technologies that enable high-purity, large-diameter silicon materials with superior crystal quality and cost efficiency, supporting advanced chip etching processes down to 7nm and below. Its integrated production capability from crystal growth to finished silicon components ensures product consistency and supply reliability. The company’s products meet stringent international standards and support domestic semiconductor supply chain security, offering customized solutions and strong technical support to customers, differentiating it in a high-barrier, technology-intensive market.
